location: DGS India - Bengaluru - Manyata N1 Block
jobDescription:
Role Summary We are looking for an experienced Procurement Lead/Manager to drive strategic sourcing, supplier management, contract negotiations, and procurement operations across multiple categories including IT, facilities, HR services, and corporate functions. Role Summary We are looking for an experienced Procurement Lead/Manager to drive strategic sourcing, supplier management, contract negotiations, and procurement operations across multiple categories including IT, facilities, HR services, and corporate functions. title: Salesforce Associate Architect
location: DGS India - Pune - Indiqube Orchid
jobDescription:
JOB DESCRIPTION Salesforce Tech Lead / Salesforce Associate Architect Salesforce Practice | Sales Cloud · Service Cloud · Data Cloud · Agentforce
1. Role Summary Title Salesforce Tech Lead / Salesforce Associate Architect Primary Domain Sales Cloud · Service Cloud · Data Cloud · Agentforce Level Senior Individual Contributor with Team Lead Responsibilities Reporting To Salesforce Practice Head / Engagement Delivery Manager A senior Salesforce generalist-specialist who leads solution design and delivery across the core CRM platform and the data and AI layer. Sales Cloud and Service Cloud form the CRM backbone of every engagement. Data Cloud and Agentforce extend those foundations with unified customer intelligence and AI-powered automation. The role carries team lead accountability — governing architecture, mentoring engineers, and serving as the primary technical interface with clients. Marketing Cloud knowledge is a valued complement, particularly for Data Cloud ingestion design.
2. Key Skills ■ Required Skill ■ Must-Have Skill ■ Desired Skill Sales Cloud • Lead-to-Opportunity lifecycle, pipeline management, forecasting & territory models • CPQ fundamentals, Product Catalogue, Pricebook design & Approval Processes • Einstein Activity Capture, Sales Engagement, and rep productivity tooling • Account & Contact hierarchies, Duplicate Management, and data quality governance REQUIRED Service Cloud • Case management, Entitlements, SLA / Milestones, and Escalation Rules • Omni-Channel routing, Skills-based assignment, and Agent Workspace configuration • Knowledge Base architecture, article lifecycle, and self-service portal (Experience Cloud) • Field Service Lightning fundamentals and CTI integration awareness REQUIRED Data Cloud • Data Streams, DMO design, field mapping & standard schema governance • Identity Resolution — match rules, reconciliation rules, merge & unlink strategies • Calculated Insights, Streaming Insights, Segmentation & Activation • Customer 360 profile assembly; surfacing unified data to Sales & Service reps • Data reconciliation controls, job monitoring, retention & governance REQUIRED Agentforce • Topics, Actions, Instructions & Prompt Templates in Agent Builder • Grounding agents with Data Cloud unified profile via RAG patterns • Einstein Trust Layer — data masking, zero-retention & audit trail • Use case design: Sales assist, Service resolution, personalised outreach MUST-HAVE Marketing Cloud • Marketing Cloud Connector for Data Cloud: Contact, Subscriber & engagement event ingestion • Journey Builder, Email Studio & Automation Studio working knowledge • Consent & suppression propagation; closed-loop activation back into Data Cloud DESIRED Data Architecture & BI Integration • Batch ETL, CDC, event streaming & API ingestion — pattern selection per source • SQL for Calculated Insights, ad hoc validation & reconciliation queries • Power BI / Tableau connector patterns from Data Cloud; report-ready entity design REQUIRED
3. Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership & Solution Design Own solution architecture across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, and Agentforce workstreams — producing SDDs, data flow diagrams, and integration design documents. Lead, mentor, and review the work of a Salesforce engineering team; act as the primary technical escalation point across all platform layers. Present architecture decisions and trade-offs confidently to client stakeholders, business owners, and enterprise architects. Sales Cloud & Service Cloud Delivery Design and deliver end-to-end Sales Cloud solutions — lead management, opportunity lifecycle, forecasting, CPQ, and Einstein-assisted productivity tooling. Architect Service Cloud solutions covering case management, Omni-Channel routing, Knowledge, and self-service portals; ensure seamless hand-off between sales and service processes. Govern data quality, duplicate management, and object model integrity across the CRM platform. Data Cloud — Ingestion, Identity & Activation Design multi-source ingestion pipelines and DMO structures; architect Identity Resolution to produce a trusted Unified Individual Profile and Customer 360 view. Build Calculated Insights and Segments that drive activation across marketing and service channels; surface Customer 360 to Sales and Service reps via embedded components and CRM Analytics. Establish source-to-target reconciliation controls, data quality alerts, and retention policies; integrate Data Cloud data with Power BI / Tableau for enterprise reporting. Agentforce Implementation Architect and build Data Cloud-grounded Agentforce agents for Sales assist, Service resolution, and Marketing personalisation use cases. Configure Trust Layer guardrails and RAG retrieval strategies; define autonomous vs. assistive automation boundaries per use case. Marketing Cloud Integration (Desired) Design Marketing Cloud as a Data Cloud source system — governing connector configuration, engagement event ingestion, and closed-loop activation back into Journey Builder.
4. Certifications Certifications marked ★ are considered essential for this role; others are advantageous. ★ Sales Cloud Consultant ★ Service Cloud Consultant ★ Data Cloud Consultant ★ Salesforce Data Architect ★ Agentforce Specialist Salesforce AI Associate Marketing Cloud Consultant CRM Analytics & Einstein Tableau Desktop Specialist This document is confidential and intended for internal recruitment use only. Experience in test automation using tools and frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Web Driver.io, Cypress, or equivalent. Good knowledge of API testing using tools such as Postman, Soap UI, REST Assured, or similar. Experience working with both RESTful and SOAP APIs. Strong knowledge of SQL queries for data validation, backend testing, and troubleshooting. Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into effective test cases and acceptance criteria. Experience in identifying, analysing, logging, tracking, and reporting defects using tools such as Jira, Azure Dev Ops, Rally, or equivalent. Strong defect analysis skills with the ability to collaborate closely with developers, business analysts, product owners, and cross-functional teams for issue resolution. Experience in creating and maintaining regression test suites, integration test suites, and test data. Ability to participate in requirement walkthroughs, design discussions, sprint ceremonies, and release planning. Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodology and experience working in sprint-based delivery models. Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Jenkins, Git Hub Actions, Git Lab CI, Azure Dev Ops, or similar. Strong communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate quality risks, test progress, defects, and release readiness. Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a fast-paced delivery environment. Experience Should have a minimum of 7+ years of experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Engineering. Experience working in product development, digital platforms, enterprise applications, BFSI, healthcare, retail, telecom, or technology services environments would be preferred. Prior experience in both manual and automation testing is expected. Experience in working with distributed teams and stakeholders across business, development, QA, Dev Ops, and product management teams. Good-to-Have Qualifications & Skills Certifications such as ISTQB Foundation/Advanced Level, Certified Agile Tester, Scrum Master, or equivalent. Experience in building or enhancing test automation frameworks. Knowledge of BDD/TDD practices and tools such as Cucumber, Spec Flow, JUnit, Test NG, or similar. Programming or scripting experience in Java, Java Script, Type Script, Python, or similar languages. Understanding of object-oriented programming concepts. Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines. Knowledge of performance testing tools such as JMeter, Load Runner, Gatling, or equivalent. Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. Experience in mobile testing across Android and i OS platforms would be an added advantage. Experience with accessibility testing, security testing basics, or cross-browser compatibility testing. Domain knowledge in financial services, insurance, healthcare, e-commerce, or Saa S-based platforms would be beneficial. Additional Skills Strong understanding of manual and automated QA practices. Ability to develop and implement comprehensive test strategies and test plans to validate software functionality and ensure compliance with established quality standards. Collaboration with cross-functional teams to analyze requirements, participate in design discussions, and contribute to acceptance criteria. Ability to assess testing scope, identify risks, estimate testing effort, and plan testing activities accordingly. Experience in preparing test summary reports, defect reports, test execution dashboards, and release sign-off documentation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Attention to detail and strong ownership of quality outcomes. Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple deliverables in a deadline-driven environment. Good understanding of business processes and ability to validate end-to-end workflows. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to mentor junior QA team members and contribute to QA best practices. Location: DGS India

Establish logging, observability, and operational dashboards. Drive best practices for production support and operational excellence. With best-in-class services and solutions in Media, CXM (Customer Expeclients in finance, banking, NBFCs, or financial services rience Management) and Creative, Dentsu India is the 2nd biggest Advertising agency network in India while the dentsu international is the 5th largest in the world. Role Summary: Designation: Associate Manager – Account Management Job Location: Bengaluru Experience: 3+ years of agency experience in digital account management, client servicing, or digital marketing. We are looking for an experienced Associate Manager – Account Management to join dentsu's client servicing team. The ideal candidate should have a strong digital background with exposure to integrated marketing campaigns and a working understanding of mainline advertising. This role requires managing day-to-day client relationships, driving campaign execution, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver impactful marketing solutions. Key Accountabilities Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned client accounts and build strong client relationships. Manage end-to-end execution of integrated marketing campaigns across digital platforms. Coordinate with Creative, Strategy, Media, Content, and Production teams to ensure timely project delivery. Monitor campaign performance and work with internal teams to identify optimization opportunities. Ensure deliverables meet client expectations, timelines, and business objectives. Maintain strong stakeholder communication and proactively resolve client queries. Qualifications & Requisite Skills: 3+ years of experience in Account Management/Client Servicing within an advertising or digital agency. Strong experience handling digital marketing campaigns, with exposure to social media, content, influencer marketing, and integrated campaigns. Basic understanding of mainline advertising. Excellent client management, project management, and stakeholder management skills. Strong communication and presentation skills. Ability to work in a fast-paced agency environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously. Malayalam-speaking candidates are preferred. Prior experience handling finance, banking, NBFC, or financial services clients will be an added advantage. location: DGS India - Pune - Kharadi EON Free Zone
jobDescription: Position Overview We are seeking an accomplished and strategic Lead Front-End Developer with extensive expertise in Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) and in-depth knowledge of Storefront Reference Architecture (SFRA). This pivotal leadership role demands a seasoned professional capable of architecting and overseeing the development of scalable, high-performance, and visually compelling e Commerce solutions. The successful candidate will lead a team of front-end engineers, foster best practices, and collaborate cross-functionally to ensure seamless integration of UI/UX designs with back-end business logic while maintaining rigorous standards for code quality, accessibility, and maintainability. Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership and Architectural Oversight Define and drive the front-end architecture strategy for SFCC initiatives, ensuring solutions are scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance. Provide leadership and mentorship to front-end development teams, instilling best practices around SFRA, modular design, and robust coding standards. Strong expertise in front-end performance optimization strategies, including code splitting, lazy loading, and critical CSS management. Strategic mindset with a passion for continuous improvement and adoption of emerging front-end technologies. Preferred Qualifications Salesforce Certifications or equivalent credentials. location: DGS India - Pune - Kharadi EON Free Zone
jobDescription:
Job Title: Senior Business Analyst (SAP BTP & SAP ERP) Experience: 8–10 Years Location: Pune Employment Type: Full-time Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Senior Business Analyst with strong functional expertise in SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) and SAP ERP modules, along with experience in custom enterprise application development. The candidate will act as a bridge between business stakeholders, designers, and technical teams, ensuring seamless communication and delivery of high-quality solutions aligned with business needs. Key Responsibilities Business Analysis & Requirement Gathering Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand and document functional and technical requirements. Translate business needs into clear Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Specifications (FS), and user stories. Conduct workshops, interviews, and requirement elicitation sessions. SAP Expertise Apply functional knowledge of SAP BTP components (e.g., Integration Suite, Extension Suite, Workflow, Analytics). Work with SAP ERP modules (such as FI/CO, MM, SD, or others) to define business processes and system enhancements. Support implementation, enhancements, and integration initiatives across SAP landscapes. Custom Enterprise Applications Lead analysis for custom-built enterprise applications, ensuring scalability and usability. Coordinate with development teams during the design and build phases. Validate system behavior through UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and ensure business alignment. Client Communication Act as the primary point of contact for business stakeholders and clients. Communicate project updates, risks, and dependencies effectively. Build and maintain strong client relationships with proactive engagement. Collaboration with Design Teams Work closely with UX/UI designers to ensure business requirements are translated into intuitive user experiences. Provide functional insights into wireframes, prototypes, and user journeys. Ensure that design solutions align with user expectations and business goals. Tools & Agile Practices Use Miro for workshops, brainstorming sessions, journey mapping, and stakeholder collaboration. Participate in Agile ceremonies (Sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives). Manage and track requirements using tools like JIRA, Confluence, or equivalent. Required Skills & Qualifications Core Skills 8–10 years of experience as a Business Analyst. Strong functional expertise in SAP BTP and SAP ERP modules. Experience in custom enterprise application lifecycle management. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Technical & Functional Skills Good understanding of SAP integrations and workflows. Ability to work with cross-functional teams (developers, architects, designers). Experience in process modeling tools and documentation. Collaboration & Design Understanding Hands-on experience with Miro or similar collaboration tools. Strong understanding of user experience (UX) principles. Ability to effectively communicate business needs to designers and UI teams. Soft Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Excellent presentation and facilitation skills. Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities. Preferred Qualifications Experience in Agile/Scrum methodology. SAP certifications (BTP / ERP modules) are a plus. Experience in digital transformation or enterprise modernization projects. Location: DGS India

title: Lead Architect
location: DGS India - Bengaluru - Manyata H2 block
jobDescription:
AI Solutions Lead/AI (Associate) Architect Role Overview We are seeking an AI Solutions Lead to architect, govern, and grow our AI delivery practice across Gen AI, Agentic AI, and applied ML engagements. This is a hands-on and hybrid role that includes architecting AI solutions and shaping the growth of the AI practice. This role is suited for someone who has earned technical fluency with Gen AI and agentic AI on top of a strong foundation in classical ML and deep learning — and who is now ready to set the technical direction for a growing team. The role is a hybrid lead position: leading solutions for multiple AI delivery pods, partnering with engineering and DX leadership, and owning the craft of the practice — driving solution architectures, evaluation standards, reusable components, and the technical bar for the AI delivery team. The expectation is depth and breadth showcased across the portfolio of AI work done so far, preferably in multimodal agentic systems, SLM design, ML and DL solutions, and enterprise deployments, while consistently raising the standards at which the team operates. Key Responsibilities Solution Architecture & Technical Direction Translate business problems from clients into staged, defensible AI solution roadmaps working with business leaders through pre-sales and project delivery cycles. Lead solutioning, support architecture for end-to-end AI solutions across Gen AI, Agentic AI, multimodal, and applied ML use cases, with explicit trade-off analysis on model class (frontier vs. SLM vs. fine-tuned), retrieval design, memory, and orchestration. Own the practice's reference architectures and solution design patterns for multimodal agentic systems, including planning, tool use, memory, grounding, and inter-agent communication (MCP, A2A). Conduct solution design reviews across concurrent client engagements; facilitate subjective technical decisions and enable delivery excellence. Multimodal Agentic Systems & SLM Design Design and lead the build of multi-agent systems with reasoning, planning, tool use, persistent memory, and grounded retrieval. Guide multimodal system design across text, vision, speech, and structured data, including ingestion, representation, and downstream agent reasoning. Establish patterns for SLM design and adoption — distillation, fine-tuning, quantization, and routing — to meet enterprise constraints on cost, latency, data residency, and on-prem/edge deployment. Define hybrid retrieval and knowledge architectures spanning vector, graph (KG), and No SQL stores; lead KG-assisted retrieval, entity linking, and structured grounding. Eval, Guardrails & Production Quality Establish evaluation as a first-class discipline: design eval frameworks, golden datasets, regression suites, automated and human-in-the-loop evals, and observability for agentic and generative systems. Define and enforce safety, guardrail, and hallucination-control standards across the practice; lead red-teaming and adversarial testing for high-stakes deployments. Set the bar for production readiness — reliability, latency, cost, monitoring, drift detection, and incident response — for AI systems in regulated, enterprise-grade environments. Drive enterprise deployment best practices across cloud hyper-scalers, on-prem, and edge, including GPU/accelerator ops, model serving, and lifecycle automation. Practice Building & Technical Mentorship
- Shape the practice's capability roadmap: which techniques to invest in, which to retire, and how the team stays at the leading edge of Gen AI and agentic AI. Mentor AI Engineers and Lead AI Engineers; run technical reviews, pairing sessions, and internal knowledge exchange on agentic, multimodal, and SLM topics. Set the technical hiring bar; lead architecture and senior engineering interviews and calibrate the team's evaluation standards. Establish and promote AI in SDLC frameworks on delivery projects Cross-functional Leadership & Delivery Partner with engineering, data science, product, and DX leadership on delivery and acceleration initiatives Engage with client and stakeholder leadership on architecture, feasibility, and risk; communicate technical direction clearly to non-technical audiences. Support pre-sales and solutioning for new Gen AI and Agentic AI opportunities, including effort estimation, architectural framing, and capability storytelling. Required Technical Skills – Programming & Engineering: Python (advanced), SQL; strong API and backend engineering in Fast API/Flask/Django; production-grade software practices. Generative AI: LLMs and SLMs, RAG/Agentic RAG, multimodal architectures, agents, prompt engineering, grounding, knowledge graphs, fine-tuning (SFT, Lo RA/QLo RA, RLHF/RLAIF), distillation, and quantization. Agentic AI: Multi-agent orchestration, planning, tool use, persistent memory, MCP and A2A patterns; frameworks such as Lang Graph, Llama Index, Auto Gen. Eval & Safety: Eval framework design, golden datasets, automated and human evals, red-teaming, guardrails, hallucination control, observability for AI systems. Machine Learning & Deep Learning: Predictive modeling, deep learning (CNNs, RNNs/LSTMs, Transformers), embeddings, vector search, classical ML; CV, NLP, and time-series exposure. Cloud, MLOps & Deployment: AWS, Azure, or GCP at depth; model serving, GPU/accelerator ops, CI/CD, monitoring, on-prem and edge deployment patterns. Data Engineering: Kafka, Spark/Flink, Hadoop, Mongo DB and other No SQL/graph/vector stores; large-scale streaming and batch pipelines. Math Foundations: Linear algebra, probability, statistics, optimization. Experience with commerce cloud ecosystems (good to have) – Salesforce and Adobe Experience Requirements – 10–12 years of hands-on experience building and deploying ML, DL, and AI systems in production, with progression into solution architecture and technical leadership 10+ years of demonstrable experience working with global businesses, delivering on large accounts 3+ years of demonstrable hands-on work in Gen AI and/or Agentic AI — beyond prompt engineering and basic RAG — including multi-agent systems, custom fine-tuning, multimodal pipelines, or SLM-based deployments. Proven track record of architecting and shipping AI systems in enterprise-grade environments, including regulated or high-stakes domains. 3+ Experience leading ML-AI technical pods or teams (formal or dotted-line), mentoring senior engineers, and setting hiring and review standards. Attitude & Mindset You must have an architect's mindset and equipped with a builder's hands. You must be agile and current — actively in the thick of Gen AI and agentic developments, learning and shipping at the pace the field demands, with strong fundamentals and understanding of the domain Excellent communicator — able to explain agentic, multimodal, and SLM trade-offs clearly to engineering peers, business stakeholders, and clients. Open and flexible toward a hybrid work structure with no less than 3 days work from office — to ensure regular connection and cross-project knowledge exchange across the AI practice. Skills Matrix Skill Category AI Solutions Lead Solution Architecture Owns reference architectures across multiple concurrent AI engagements; sets patterns for agentic, multimodal, and SLM-based systems. Transformers & Deep Learning Deep practical grounding in transformers, fine-tuning (SFT, Lo RA/QLo RA, RLHF/RLAIF), distillation, quantization, and SLM design for cost/latency-bound deployments. Generative AI (LLMs & Multimodal) Designs hybrid multimodal RAG, KAG, and grounded-generation systems; selects the right model class (frontier vs. SLM vs. fine-tuned) per use case. Agentic Frameworks Architects multi-agent orchestration, planning, memory, tool use, and inter-agent communication patterns including MCP and A2A. Eval, Safety & Guardrails Establishes evaluation frameworks, hallucination control, red-teaming, regression suites, and observability as a first-class engineering discipline. Information Retrieval & Knowledge Designs hybrid dense–sparse retrieval, ranking, KG-augmented retrieval, and unified knowledge layers across vector, graph, and No SQL stores. Predictive & Classical ML Strong foundation in classical ML and DL (CV, NLP, time-series, GNNs); able to choose non-Gen AI approaches when they fit better. Conversational AI Architects multi-turn, multilingual, multimodal dialogue systems with grounded responses and structured evaluation. Model Deployment Drives enterprise deployment patterns — cloud, on-prem, and edge — including GPU/accelerator ops, scaling, CI/CD, and lifecycle automation. Cloud & MLOps End-to-end model and agent lifecycle on AWS/Azure/GCP; cost, latency, and reliability optimization at production scale. Data Engineering & Pipelines Designs streaming and batch pipelines (Kafka, Spark, Flink) and the data foundations that production AI systems depend on. Practice Leadership Sets the technical bar for hiring, mentoring, code/architecture reviews, and reusable IP; grows the AI practice as a craft. Location: DGS India

jobDescription:
Experience 10–15 Years of professional experience in Market Research with expertise in research design, project management, execution, analysis, and client reporting. Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Senior Market Research Professional to lead end-to-end quantitative research projects. The role involves managing the complete research lifecycle—from proposal development and research design to data analysis, insight generation, and client presentations. The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical capabilities, excellent stakeholder management skills, and the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights. Key Skills Quantitative Market Research Proposal Writing & Research Design Questionnaire Development Sampling & Analysis Planning Data Analysis using SPSS, Q, and Display R Advanced Statistical Techniques: Conjoint Analysis Max Diff Analysis Driver Analysis Segmentation Multiple Linear Regression Data Cleaning & Data Processing Report Development & Insight Generation Data Storytelling & Client Presentations Project & Stakeholder Management Key Responsibilities Define research objectives and develop research proposals. Design quantitative research methodologies and questionnaires. Develop sampling plans and coordinate with fieldwork partners. Manage end-to-end research projects, ensuring timely delivery and quality. Collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to achieve project objectives. Support and oversee data collection, validation, and analysis. Interpret research findings and deliver actionable insights through reports and presentations. Manage project budgets and ensure efficient resource utilization. Build and maintain strong client relationships to drive repeat business. Ensure adherence to project timelines, quality standards, and client expectations. Requirements Bachelor's or Postgraduate degree in a relevant discipline. 10–15 years of experience in market research, including project management, research design, execution, analysis, and reporting. Strong expertise in quantitative research methodologies (qualitative research exposure is an advantage). Hands-on experience with SPSS, Q, and Display R. Strong knowledge of advanced statistical techniques, including Conjoint, Max Diff, Segmentation, Driver Analysis, and Regression. Excellent analytical, presentation, communication, and storytelling skills. Experience managing global research projects across North America, Europe, and Asia. Industry experience across one or more sectors such as FMCG, Healthcare, Automotive, Telecom, IT, Financial Services, Energy, and Public Sector. Proven ability to independently manage projects from proposal through final client presentation. Strong problem-solving, multitasking, and stakeholder management capabilities with high attention to detail. Location: DGS India

title: Devops Frontend Engineer
location: DGS India - Bengaluru - Manyata N1 Block
jobDescription:
Job Title: Devops Frontend Engineer (React/Next.js) Experience: 3 to 6 years Job Summary We are looking for a skilled and motivated Dev Ops Frontend Engineer with strong experience in React.js, Next.js, Type Script, and modern frontend engineering practices, along with hands-on exposure to CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, containerization, and Dev Ops workflows. The ideal candidate will be responsible for building scalable, high-performance, and user-friendly web applications while ensuring smooth build, deployment, and release processes. This role requires close collaboration with product managers, UI/UX designers, backend engineers, QA teams, and Dev Ops teams to deliver reliable and production-ready digital solutions. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of frontend development and Dev Ops automation Roles & Responsibilities Develop, test, and maintain responsive web applications using React.js, Next.js, Type Script, Java Script, HTML5, and CSS3. Build reusable frontend components and libraries for future use. Translate UI/UX designs from tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch into pixel-perfect, responsive, and accessible user interfaces. Work with Next.js features such as server-side rendering, static site generation, routing, middleware, and API routes. Integrate frontend applications with backend services using REST APIs and Graph QL APIs. Implement and manage state using tools such as Redux, Zustand, Context API, or React Query. Optimize applications for maximum speed, scalability, SEO, and performance. Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines for frontend applications using tools such as Git Hub Actions, Git Lab CI/CD, Jenkins, Azure Dev Ops, or Bitbucket Pipelines. Manage frontend build and deployment processes across development, staging, UAT, and production environments. Work with containerization tools such as Docker for application packaging and deployment. Collaborate with Dev Ops and infrastructure teams for deployments on cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. Configure and manage environment variables, build configurations, and deployment scripts. Monitor frontend application performance using tools such as Lighthouse, Web Vitals, Sentry, Datadog, New Relic, or similar tools. Ensure code quality through code reviews, linting, formatting, unit testing, and best engineering practices. Write clean, maintainable, scalable, and well-documented code. Troubleshoot build failures, deployment issues, frontend bugs, and production incidents. Participate in Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, demos, and retrospectives. Stay updated with the latest frontend, Dev Ops, cloud, and web performance trends Qualifications & Skills Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience will also be considered. 3 to 5 years of professional experience in frontend development using React.js and modern Java Script frameworks. Strong hands-on experience with React.js and Next.js. Good understanding of Java Script ES6+, Type Script, HTML5, CSS3, SCSS, Tailwind CSS, or styled-components. Strong knowledge of React fundamentals including functional components, hooks, Context API, component lifecycle, performance optimization, and reusable component design. Experience with Next.js concepts such as server-side rendering (SSR), static site generation (SSG), incremental static regeneration (ISR), file-based routing, middleware, image optimization, and API routes. Experience integrating applications with RESTful APIs and Graph QL APIs. Familiarity with frontend state management libraries such as Redux, Zustand, React Query, or Context API. Good understanding of responsive design, browser compatibility, accessibility, and mobile-first development. Hands-on experience with Git-based workflows, branching strategies, pull requests, and code reviews. Minimum 2 years Handson practical experience with CI/CD pipelines (Git Hub Actions, Git Lab CI/CD, Jenkins, Azure Dev Ops, Bitbucket ) and frontend deployment automation. Experience with build tools and package managers such as Webpack, Vite, Babel, npm, Yarn, or pnpm. Basic to intermediate knowledge of Docker and containerized application deployment. Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. Understanding of web servers, hosting platforms, and deployment services such as Nginx, Vercel, Netlify, AWS S3, Cloud Front, Azure Static Web Apps, or similar platforms. Familiarity with frontend testing frameworks such as Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, or Playwright. Good understanding of performance optimization techniques including lazy loading, code splitting, caching, bundle optimization, and Core Web Vitals. Knowledge of security best practices for frontend applications, including secure API usage, token handling, CSP, and dependency vulnerability management. Strong problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills. Good communication skills and ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment. Nice to Have Experience working with micro-frontends or modular frontend architecture. Experience with Kubernetes or container orchestration platforms. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Cloud Formation, or Bicep. Experience with monitoring and logging tools such as Sentry, Datadog, New Relic, Grafana, Prometheus, or ELK Stack. Exposure to headless CMS platforms such as Contentful, Strapi, Sanity, or Adobe Experience Manager. Familiarity with commerce or e-commerce platforms such as Shopify, Magento, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, or commercetools. Experience with analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Segment, or Mixpanel. Understanding of SEO best practices in a Next.js environment. Knowledge of accessibility standards such as WCAG. Experience working in Agile/Scrum-based development teams. Exposure to API gateway, CDN, caching, and edge deployment concepts. Experience with automated release management and versioning strategies. Location: DGS India

title: Lead Architect
location: DGS India - Bengaluru - Manyata N1 Block
jobDescription:
AI Solutions Lead/AI (Associate) Architect Role Overview We are seeking an AI Solutions Lead to architect, govern, and grow our AI delivery practice across Gen AI, Agentic AI, and applied ML engagements. This is a hands-on and hybrid role that includes architecting AI solutions and shaping the growth of the AI practice. This role is suited for someone who has earned technical fluency with Gen AI and agentic AI on top of a strong foundation in classical ML and deep learning — and who is now ready to set the technical direction for a growing team. The role is a hybrid lead position: leading solutions for multiple AI delivery pods, partnering with engineering and DX leadership, and owning the craft of the practice — driving solution architectures, evaluation standards, reusable components, and the technical bar for the AI delivery team. The expectation is depth and breadth showcased across the portfolio of AI work done so far, preferably in multimodal agentic systems, SLM design, ML and DL solutions, and enterprise deployments, while consistently raising the standards at which the team operates. Key Responsibilities Solution Architecture & Technical Direction Translate business problems from clients into staged, defensible AI solution roadmaps working with business leaders through pre-sales and project delivery cycles. Lead solutioning, support architecture for end-to-end AI solutions across Gen AI, Agentic AI, multimodal, and applied ML use cases, with explicit trade-off analysis on model class (frontier vs. SLM vs. fine-tuned), retrieval design, memory, and orchestration. Own the practice's reference architectures and solution design patterns for multimodal agentic systems, including planning, tool use, memory, grounding, and inter-agent communication (MCP, A2A). Conduct solution design reviews across concurrent client engagements; facilitate subjective technical decisions and enable delivery excellence. Multimodal Agentic Systems & SLM Design Design and lead the build of multi-agent systems with reasoning, planning, tool use, persistent memory, and grounded retrieval. Guide multimodal system design across text, vision, speech, and structured data, including ingestion, representation, and downstream agent reasoning. Establish patterns for SLM design and adoption — distillation, fine-tuning, quantization, and routing — to meet enterprise constraints on cost, latency, data residency, and on-prem/edge deployment. Define hybrid retrieval and knowledge architectures spanning vector, graph (KG), and No SQL stores; lead KG-assisted retrieval, entity linking, and structured grounding. Eval, Guardrails & Production Quality Establish evaluation as a first-class discipline: design eval frameworks, golden datasets, regression suites, automated and human-in-the-loop evals, and observability for agentic and generative systems. Define and enforce safety, guardrail, and hallucination-control standards across the practice; lead red-teaming and adversarial testing for high-stakes deployments. Set the bar for production readiness — reliability, latency, cost, monitoring, drift detection, and incident response — for AI systems in regulated, enterprise-grade environments. Drive enterprise deployment best practices across cloud hyper-scalers, on-prem, and edge, including GPU/accelerator ops, model serving, and lifecycle automation. Practice Building & Technical Mentorship
- Shape the practice's capability roadmap: which techniques to invest in, which to retire, and how the team stays at the leading edge of Gen AI and agentic AI. Mentor AI Engineers and Lead AI Engineers; run technical reviews, pairing sessions, and internal knowledge exchange on agentic, multimodal, and SLM topics. Set the technical hiring bar; lead architecture and senior engineering interviews and calibrate the team's evaluation standards. Establish and promote AI in SDLC frameworks on delivery projects Cross-functional Leadership & Delivery Partner with engineering, data science, product, and DX leadership on delivery and acceleration initiatives Engage with client and stakeholder leadership on architecture, feasibility, and risk; communicate technical direction clearly to non-technical audiences. Support pre-sales and solutioning for new Gen AI and Agentic AI opportunities, including effort estimation, architectural framing, and capability storytelling. Required Technical Skills – Programming & Engineering: Python (advanced), SQL; strong API and backend engineering in Fast API/Flask/Django; production-grade software practices. Generative AI: LLMs and SLMs, RAG/Agentic RAG, multimodal architectures, agents, prompt engineering, grounding, knowledge graphs, fine-tuning (SFT, Lo RA/QLo RA, RLHF/RLAIF), distillation, and quantization. Agentic AI: Multi-agent orchestration, planning, tool use, persistent memory, MCP and A2A patterns; frameworks such as Lang Graph, Llama Index, Auto Gen. Eval & Safety: Eval framework design, golden datasets, automated and human evals, red-teaming, guardrails, hallucination control, observability for AI systems. Machine Learning & Deep Learning: Predictive modeling, deep learning (CNNs, RNNs/LSTMs, Transformers), embeddings, vector search, classical ML; CV, NLP, and time-series exposure. Cloud, MLOps & Deployment: AWS, Azure, or GCP at depth; model serving, GPU/accelerator ops, CI/CD, monitoring, on-prem and edge deployment patterns. Data Engineering: Kafka, Spark/Flink, Hadoop, Mongo DB and other No SQL/graph/vector stores; large-scale streaming and batch pipelines. Math Foundations: Linear algebra, probability, statistics, optimization. Experience with commerce cloud ecosystems (good to have) – Salesforce and Adobe Experience Requirements – 10–12 years of hands-on experience building and deploying ML, DL, and AI systems in production, with progression into solution architecture and technical leadership 10+ years of demonstrable experience working with global businesses, delivering on large accounts 3+ years of demonstrable hands-on work in Gen AI and/or Agentic AI — beyond prompt engineering and basic RAG — including multi-agent systems, custom fine-tuning, multimodal pipelines, or SLM-based deployments. Proven track record of architecting and shipping AI systems in enterprise-grade environments, including regulated or high-stakes domains. 3+ Experience leading ML-AI technical pods or teams (formal or dotted-line), mentoring senior engineers, and setting hiring and review standards. Attitude & Mindset You must have an architect's mindset and equipped with a builder's hands. You must be agile and current — actively in the thick of Gen AI and agentic developments, learning and shipping at the pace the field demands, with strong fundamentals and understanding of the domain Excellent communicator — able to explain agentic, multimodal, and SLM trade-offs clearly to engineering peers, business stakeholders, and clients. Open and flexible toward a hybrid work structure with no less than 3 days work from office — to ensure regular connection and cross-project knowledge exchange across the AI practice. Skills Matrix Skill Category AI Solutions Lead Solution Architecture Owns reference architectures across multiple concurrent AI engagements; sets patterns for agentic, multimodal, and SLM-based systems. Transformers & Deep Learning Deep practical grounding in transformers, fine-tuning (SFT, Lo RA/QLo RA, RLHF/RLAIF), distillation, quantization, and SLM design for cost/latency-bound deployments. Generative AI (LLMs & Multimodal) Designs hybrid multimodal RAG, KAG, and grounded-generation systems; selects the right model class (frontier vs. SLM vs. fine-tuned) per use case. Agentic Frameworks Architects multi-agent orchestration, planning, memory, tool use, and inter-agent communication patterns including MCP and A2A. Eval, Safety & Guardrails Establishes evaluation frameworks, hallucination control, red-teaming, regression suites, and observability as a first-class engineering discipline. Information Retrieval & Knowledge Designs hybrid dense–sparse retrieval, ranking, KG-augmented retrieval, and unified knowledge layers across vector, graph, and No SQL stores. Predictive & Classical ML Strong foundation in classical ML and DL (CV, NLP, time-series, GNNs); able to choose non-Gen AI approaches when they fit better. Conversational AI Architects multi-turn, multilingual, multimodal dialogue systems with grounded responses and structured evaluation. Model Deployment Drives enterprise deployment patterns — cloud, on-prem, and edge — including GPU/accelerator ops, scaling, CI/CD, and lifecycle automation. Cloud & MLOps End-to-end model and agent lifecycle on AWS/Azure/GCP; cost, latency, and reliability optimization at production scale. Data Engineering & Pipelines Designs streaming and batch pipelines (Kafka, Spark, Flink) and the data foundations that production AI systems depend on. Practice Leadership Sets the technical bar for hiring, mentoring, code/architecture reviews, and reusable IP; grows the AI practice as a craft. Location: DGS India

title: Project Manager
location: DGS India - Pune - Kharadi EON Free Zone
jobDescription:
Job Title: Project Manager Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Project Manager to lead and deliver projects within agreed scope, timelines, budgets, and quality standards. The ideal candidate will possess excellent leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills, ensuring smooth execution and alignment with organizational objectives. Key Responsibilities
1. Project Leadership Lead and manage the project team to deliver agreed outputs/outcomes within defined scope, time, cost, and quality constraints. Promote ethical, legal, and socially responsible practices while engaging with stakeholders and team members.
2. Project Team Management Define, delegate, and manage team and stakeholder roles and responsibilities. Develop team capability, foster innovation, and motivate team members to achieve successful project outcomes.
3. Business Case & Benefits Management Support the project sponsor in preparing and updating business cases, ensuring alignment with forecasted benefits, costs, and risks. Track and report progress to ensure realization of planned business benefits.
4. Budget & Cost Management Prepare, manage, and control project budgets. Monitor forecasts, changes, and actual costs to ensure financial compliance.
5. Governance Establish and maintain effective project governance and decision-making structures. Define clear roles, responsibilities, and accountabilities in line with organizational standards.
6. Project Planning & Controls Develop and document key project components, including scope, schedule, approach, resources, budgets, risks, and quality requirements. Implement protocols for scope changes and update project configuration documents as needed.
7. Scheduling & Dependency Management Create and maintain project schedules considering dependencies, resource needs, and constraints. Map project dependencies, assign ownership, and actively manage interdependencies with related projects.
8. Resource Management Develop and maintain resource allocation plans (excluding financial resources), considering availability and scheduling variations.
9. Stakeholder & Communication Management Identify key stakeholders and manage relationships, communication, and engagement strategies. Ensure alignment with program, portfolio, and organizational communication requirements. Resolve conflicts between individuals or interest groups to maintain smooth project operations.
10. Risk & Issue Management Identify, monitor, and mitigate project risks (threats and opportunities) and issues. Escalate concerns as appropriate and manage interdependencies with related projects. Qualifications & Skills Bachelor’s degree in Business, IT, Engineering, or a related field (Master’s or PMP certification preferred). Proven experience in project management across the full project lifecycle. Strong budgeting, scheduling, and resource management skills. Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication abilities. Ability to manage risks, resolve conflicts, and drive successful project outcomes in a fast-paced environment. Location: DGS India

title: Manager- Business Development
location: Mumbai
jobDescription: Role Overview The Growth Operations Manager sits at the commercial heart of Dentsu's Data & Technology division, responsible for accelerating revenue through solution selling, adtech product commercialisation, and driving adoption of Dentsu's proprietary data products. This is not a passive account management role — it demands a commercially aggressive, technically fluent individual who can navigate complex product conversations, build pipelines, and close deals. The person in this seat will act as the connective tissue between product, sales, and strategy, ensuring that Dentsu's Data & Tech capabilities are packaged, positioned, and sold effectively across clients, agency teams, and ecosystem partners. Key Roles & Responsibilities Solution Selling & Revenue Growth The Growth Operations Manager owns the full commercial lifecycle for Dentsu's Data & Tech product suite. This means developing compelling value propositions, building and managing a qualified pipeline, and driving deals from initial conversation through to signed revenue. The role requires translating technically complex capabilities — data clean rooms, identity solutions, adtech platforms — into clear, outcome-driven narratives that resonate with client marketing and technology decision-makers. The manager will work closely with Client Solutions and Sales leadership to respond to RFPs, craft proposals, and identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing client relationships. Adtech Sales & Product Commercialisation A core pillar of this role is leading commercial engagements for Dentsu's adtech products — spanning demand-side platforms, measurement tools, attribution capabilities, identity solutions, and retail media offerings. The Growth Operations Manager will be the subject matter expert in adtech, able to articulate Dentsu's product differentiation against the competitive landscape including programmatic, CTV, social, and retail media. Beyond selling, this person will partner with product teams to refine commercial packaging and pricing, and will drive internal adoption within agency teams through training, toolkits, and activation support. Data Clean Rooms & Proprietary Data Products A significant and growing part of this role focuses on commercialising Dentsu's data clean room capabilities and broader data product portfolio. The manager will educate clients on privacy-safe data collaboration, first-party data onboarding, audience modelling, and cross-platform measurement use cases. They will identify and develop clean room partnership opportunities with media owners and major platforms such as Google, Meta, and Amazon, managing commercial relationships to ensure quality delivery and client satisfaction. The ability to connect technical data infrastructure to tangible client business outcomes will be critical here. Strategic Operations & Cross-Functional Collaboration Beyond direct selling, the Growth Operations Manager is responsible for the health of the commercial operation itself. This includes maintaining pipeline hygiene, owning sales forecasting, managing CRM discipline, and running regular performance reviews. The role also requires active participation in shaping the broader growth strategy of the Data & Tech division — identifying emerging opportunities in audience, identity, and measurement, and ensuring the division is commercially ready as new products come to market. The manager will represent Dentsu externally at client meetings, industry forums, and partner events as a credible voice in data-driven marketing and technology. What Success Looks Like At 3 Months In the first three months, success is about immersion and foundation-building. The manager should have a thorough understanding of Dentsu's full product portfolio, pricing architecture, and competitive positioning. They will have mapped key internal stakeholders across product, sales, data science, and agency teams, and will have initiated the first wave of external client conversations. A qualified pipeline of at least five to ten active opportunities should be in motion. Internally, CRM processes, reporting cadences, and pipeline dashboards should be set up and running. The manager should also have a clear point of view on which data clean room and adtech use cases represent the fastest and most credible path to revenue. At 6 Months By the halfway point of year one, the manager should be converting pipeline into closed revenue. This means at least two to three commercial deals signed — whether adtech product contracts, data clean room engagements, or data product activations. Internally, the manager should have become a trusted advisor to agency teams, having run product training sessions and deployed commercial toolkits that are actively being used in client conversations. The clean room pipeline should show depth, with platform partnerships initiated and at least one live client use case underway. Sales operations should be running smoothly with accurate forecasting, and the manager should be contributing meaningfully to the division's quarterly business reviews. At One Year At the twelve-month mark, success is defined by measurable, sustainable revenue contribution to the Data & Tech division. The manager should have built a robust book of commercial relationships — clients, platform partners, and agency stakeholders — and should be renewing and expanding existing engagements rather than solely hunting new ones. Revenue from adtech products and data clean room solutions should show clear growth trajectory quarter on quarter. The manager should have established themselves as a recognised commercial leader within Dentsu's Data & Tech ecosystem, contributing to product roadmap decisions, go-to-market strategy, and the broader growth narrative of the division. At this stage, the expectation is that the role has materially moved the needle on both revenue and market awareness for Dentsu's data and technology capabilities. This means at least two to three commercial deals signed — whether adtech product contracts, data clean room engagements, or data product activations. Internally, the manager should have become a trusted advisor to agency teams, having run product training sessions and deployed commercial toolkits that are actively being used in client conversations. The clean room pipeline should show depth, with platform partnerships initiated and at least one live client use case underway. Sales operations should be running smoothly with accurate forecasting, and the manager should be contributing meaningfully to the division's quarterly business reviews. At One Year At the twelve-month mark, success is defined by measurable, sustainable revenue contribution to the Data & Tech division. The manager should have built a robust book of commercial relationships — clients, platform partners, and agency stakeholders — and should be renewing and expanding existing engagements rather than solely hunting new ones. Revenue from adtech products and data clean room solutions should show clear growth trajectory quarter on quarter. The manager should have established themselves as a recognised commercial leader within Dentsu's Data & Tech ecosystem, contributing to product roadmap decisions, go-to-market strategy, and the broader growth narrative of the division. At this stage, the expectation is that the role has materially moved the needle on both revenue and market awareness for Dentsu's data and technology capabilities. jobDescription:
We are seeking a strategic, client-focused, and results-driven Performance Marketing Manager to lead and manage key paid media accounts. The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving the performance marketing strategy, overseeing campaign delivery, and ensuring client satisfaction through continuous performance optimization and operational excellence. This role acts as the primary point of contact for clients and plays a critical role in account planning, execution, and growth. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Strategy Development & Execution • Partner with the PPC Director and clients to develop comprehensive performance marketing strategies aligned with business goals. • Ensure campaigns are executed to plan, meet defined KPIs, and follow best practices across platforms (Google, Meta, Programmatic, etc.). • Translate client objectives into actionable plans and performance roadmaps.
2. Campaign & Account Management • Lead the day-to-day execution of campaigns including planning, optimization, reporting, and performance tracking. • Maintain accountability for on-time, in-budget delivery of all campaign activities. • Regularly review and improve campaign structures, bid strategies, targeting, and creatives to maximize efficiency.
3. Client Communication & Relationship Management •Act as the subject matter expert (SME) and primary point of contact for clients on performance-related discussions. •Lead weekly and monthly client meetings, performance reviews, and strategic planning sessions. •Build and sustain strong client relationships through proactive communication and delivery excellence.
4. Cross-Functional Collaboration •Work closely with Account Directors to identify and drive account growth opportunities. •Collaborate with Client Servicing and cross-channel teams (SEO, Social, Analytics, Creative) to ensure strategic alignment and integrated delivery. •Share insights and learnings across teams to drive innovation and elevate digital performance maturity.
5. Reporting & Insights •Deliver regular and ad hoc reports with actionable insights that demonstrate campaign impact and opportunities for improvement. •Use tools such as Google Analytics, Google Data Studio, and platform-specific dashboards to analyze data and generate recommendations. Required Skills &
minimumQualification: •3–5 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing with a strong background in Paid Search, Paid Social. •Proven track record of driving measurable results and successfully managing client accounts. •Strong communication and client-facing skills with experience presenting to senior stakeholders. • Expertise in tools such as Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics, and campaign management platforms (e.g., SA360, DV360). • Excellent problem-solving, analytical thinking, and project management abilities. • Ability to mentor junior team members and coordinate cross-functional collaboration.

title: Senior Manager
location: DGS India - Mumbai - Thane Ashar IT Park
jobDescription:
Solution Architect (DCF Level 45) Job Description: As a Solution Architect, you’ll be a key member of the Business Platforms team responsible for fulfilling the ongoing integrations and automation-related solutions delivered to our stakeholders. You will create solution architectures for systems and platforms ensuring all relevant options are explored for time, cost and compliance to the company’s standards, policies and practices whilst meeting the business’ requirements. The role will oversee the work of other architects and delivery of the solution for clients both internal and external, shepherding it through the relevant governance. Key Responsibilities Architectural Design & Strategy Create comprehensive blueprints, including system designs, integration plans, and technology selections. Translate complex business requirements into detailed technical specifications and architectural diagrams. Design end-to-end system architectures across various platforms (Cloud, on-premise, hybrid). Stakeholder & Team Leadership Act as a bridge between technical teams (developers, engineers) and non-technical stakeholders (executives, clients). Provide technical leadership throughout the project lifecycle, guiding development teams to ensure alignment with the architectural vision. Collaborate with project managers to manage risks, timelines, and resource allocation. Technology Evaluation & Integration Assess and recommend optimal technology stacks, tools, and frameworks based on project needs. Oversee the seamless integration of new solutions with existing enterprise infrastructure and legacy systems. Direct proof-of-concept (POC) projects to validate the feasibility of proposed solutions. Quality & Compliance Ensure all solutions meet non-functional requirements: scalability, performance, security, and reliability. Qualifications & Skills Required Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or an equivalent discipline. Strong understanding of enterprise finance processes and workflows. Extensive hands-on experience in Java, SQL, and modern application frameworks. Proven experience designing integrations, automation flows, and enterprise-scale solutions. Experience with Microsoft Power Apps, Power Automate, and Microsoft Lists. Solid experience working within common delivery methodologies (Agile and/or Waterfall). Strong problem-solving skills with sound business and technical judgment. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to simplify and structure complex technical problems. Preferred Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. Exposure to AI/ML-enabled solutions and architectures. Location: DGS India

title: Lead Technical Architect
location: DGS India - Mumbai - Thane Ashar IT Park
jobDescription:
Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Lead enterprise architecture consulting engagements. Define strategic technology roadmaps aligned with business goals Lead technical design and implementation of CDP solutions across multiple platforms Drive adoption of emerging technologies (AI-driven personalization, composable architectures). Represent organization in industry forums Define and enforce data architecture standards, schemas, and governance models Oversee ingestion pipelines (batch/streaming) and ensure data quality and integrity Guide development teams in building reusable components and scalable integrations Collaborate with marketing and analytics teams to define audience strategies and activation logic Own the orchestration of customer journeys and personalization workflows Conduct code reviews, mentor engineers, and ensure adherence to best practices Evaluate new tools and technologies to enhance CDP capabilities Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA, etc.) Act as a bridge between business and technology teams to translate requirements into actionable solutions Troubleshoot complex issues across data flows, APIs, and activation channels Contribute to roadmap planning and continuous improvement of CDP infrastructure Must have skills: Proven experience architecting and leading CDP implementations (AEP, Treasure Data, Zeta, Tealium, etc.)AEP (RT-CDP, AJO, CJA, Workfront), Action IQ, Braze (CDP), Telium, Zeta, Treasure Data, Growth Loop, Hi-Touch, SFDC etc.. Strong understanding of composable CDP architecture and data privacy principles Advanced data engineering skills including real-time and batch ingestion pipelines Expertise in API integrations (REST, SOAP, Graph QL) and event-driven architectures Proficiency in Python, Java Script, or Node.js for scripting and automation Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and big data technologies Strong understanding of identity resolution, audience segmentation, and activation workflows. Good to have skills: CDP Expertise: Adobe Experience Platform (RTCDP, AJO), Treasure Data, Tealium, Hightouch Enterprise Architecture & Consulting: TOGAF or equivalent frameworks, Solution consulting and pre-sales experience Experience with Customer Journey Orchestration tools (AJO, Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud) Familiarity with reverse ETL tools like Hightouch or Census Hands-on experience with data governance, consent management, and PII handling Knowledge of data formats and transformation (JSON, Parquet, Avro) Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Dev Ops practices Client-facing experience with stakeholder management and solution presentations Exposure to CDP evaluation and vendor selection processes Education & Qualification: Bachelors in Engineering with a specialization in Computer Science, Data , IT Graduate from other fields with good communication and analytical skills. location: Gurugram
jobDescription:
Key Responsibilities Strategic Prospecting: Identify and engage with decision-makers (CMOs, Heads of Analytics, Brand Managers) that manage significant cross-channel marketing budgets. Consultative Selling: Lead deep-dive discovery sessions to understand a prospect's current measurement stack (MTA, Last-Click, etc.) and identify gaps that our offering can solve. Product Evangelism: Simplify complex econometric concepts into compelling business narratives. You must be able to explain the "why" behind measurement, automation & data driven decision making Full Sales Cycle Management: Own the process from initial outreach and technical scoping to contract negotiation and closing. - Comfortable discussing R^2 values, p-values, and Bayesian frameworks and being able to explain why measurement will result in growth for the client's brand.
